text: Appeal of Order to Comply (Sep 17, 2018) for 325 King Street West, Unit 303.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated September 17, 2018, regarding the property located at 325 King Street West, Unit 303, Folder No. 18 225399 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to February 28, 2019.
